subject: Unaligned marketplace credits across regions — evidence & timeline
messages:
From: CompassCloud Billing <billing@compasscloud.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: ops@compasscloud.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Missing marketplace credit allocations for Jun settlements

Diego,

We're seeing an unexpected gap on our June settlements — two credit lines totaling $27,508.45 that were reported in the Marketplace invoice aren't present on the payout ledger. The invoice lines are:
- AWS invoice AWS-INV-202706-9987 (US region) — $16,200.00
- GCP invoice GCP-INV-202706-3341 (EU region) — $11,308.45

Our accounting team needs:
1) A mapping from marketplace invoice line -> seller usage record / marketplace transaction id.
2) Proof of settlement (payout id + date) or an explanation why the credit was held/backed out.
3) Any tax/VAT tags applied (we're reconciling for our auditors).

We're on a tight month-end close window — can you confirm receipt and provide an ETA for evidence? I'm attaching a CSV with the invoice extract we used (CompCloud_invoice_202706-claims.csv).

Thanks,

Maya Lin
Head of Finance Ops
CompassCloud
attachments: CompCloud_invoice_202706-claims.csv (text/csv, 42KB)

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: CompassCloud Billing <billing@compasscloud.com>

Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Missing marketplace credit allocations for Jun settlements

Maya —

Thanks for flagging and for the CSV. I've received this and will triage immediately. Quick plan:
- I'll ask Jonas to pull the marketplace metering records for the two invoice line IDs and cross-walk to Marketplace transaction ids.
- Marissa will check payout ledger and any pending holds on the seller profile.
- Naomi: please advise on VAT tagging implications if these credits are being reclassified or held for international tax review.

Can you confirm whether the AWS invoice in question was transacted under the "CompassCloud US" seller account (seller id 12345-US) or via an aggregated reseller? That affects which ledger we look up.

I'll come back with a preliminary mapping by EOD Monday PDT. Attaching our quick evidence checklist so we don't miss anything (initial-checklist.pdf).

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Finance Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: initial-checklist.pdf (application/pdf, 90KB)

Maya —

Thanks for your patience. We've completed the trace and attached a consolidated evidence bundle. Summary: 

1) AWS-INV-202706-9987 (US) — $16,200.00
   - Marketplace transaction ids: MKT-AWS-987623, MKT-AWS-987624
   - Seller account: CompassCloud US (seller id 12345-US)
   - Payout: not included in the June 10 payout run due to a manual hold flagged by MarketPay Ops for KYC discrepancy; hold placed 2027-06-08. Hold reason: missing reseller declaration.
   - Evidence: usage mapping CSV: usage-mapping-202706.csv (contains mappings and timestamps), payout hold ticket: MP-4432.pdf (referenced in bundle).

2) GCP-INV-202706-3341 (EU) — $11,308.45
   - Marketplace transaction id: MKT-GCP-3341
   - Seller account: CompassCloud EU (seller id 9876-EU)
   - Payout: attempted in Jun 12 run but reversed on Jun 14 due to VAT reclassification — finance tagged as "deferred VAT review". Evidence includes reversal journal and VAT notes.

What we provided: a single evidence ZIP containing:
- usage-mapping-202706.csv (CSV mapping invoice lines to marketplace transaction ids)
- payout-activity-12345-US.csv (payout ledger extract)
- payout-reversal-9876-EU.pdf (reversal journal)
- MP-4432.pdf (MarketPay Ops hold ticket summary)
- README.txt (timeline and checklist)

Link to evidence (secure): https://redwood-internal.s3.amazonaws.com/evidence/CMP-2027-045/evidence-bundle-20270620.zip

Next steps we recommend:
- CompassCloud: confirm whether you have a reconciled KYC declaration for the US seller id 12345-US so we can request MarketPay Ops to release the hold.
- If you want Redwood to request an expedited release, we can open a priority ticket with MarketPay Ops (there may be an associated fee).
- Naomi and Marissa are available for a short call to walk through the VAT reclassification evidence if your auditors need context.

I've cc'd MarketPay Ops and AWS support for transparency. Please let us know the preferred next step and whether you want an assisted release (I can take point).

Best,

Diego Fernandez
Finance Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
